data.fullPrompt: Remove Desk Chair completely. Remove Rolling Storage Cabinet completely. Remove Wall Letters completely. Remove Photo Garland completely. Keep #B8D4E8 — soft powder blue walls exactly as-is. Keep beige loop carpet floor exactly as-is. Warm japandi interior. White oak, cream linen, terracotta clay, brushed brass. White lacquered platform storage bed with integrated drawer compartments anchors the room. Left side: dark walnut floating nightstand 18x14 inches with caramel leather pull and aged brass hardware, topped with table lamp featuring dark walnut conical base and cream linen drum shade casting 3000K warm glow for reading. Foreground: 5x7 feet sand beige wool area rug with charcoal grey geometric border defining sleep zone over carpet. Midground: two caramel linen Euro shams and one terracotta lumbar pillow layer the bed; framed abstract art in warm ochre tones hangs eye-level on right wall at 60 inches height. Shot at eye level, 24mm equivalent, f/8, perfect exposure, professional architectural photography, photorealistic, Architectural Digest quality, no people, no text.
